gz2.ziel.turkunion.text: From the Organization of Turkic States to a union on the EU model: first free trade, then a common market, finally a common currency.
gz2.ziel.nahostordnung.text: A security order on the model of the CSCE: first a regional conference, then a security pact, finally an organisation based in Istanbul.
gz2.ziel.nahostordnung.pakt: Security pact with the Gulf and Iraq
gz2.ziel.nahostordnung.organisation: Organisation for Security in the Middle East (utopia)
gz2.ziel.drehscheibe.text: Türkiye links the continents: first the Middle Corridor, then the Development Road with Iraq, finally Istanbul as a global hub.
gz2.ziel.eubeitritt.text: Candidate since 1999, talks effectively frozen since 2018: first resume negotiations, then close chapters, finally accession.
gz2.ziel.kornkammer.text: Water, research and irrigation as in the Southeastern Anatolia Project: first self-sufficiency, then exports, finally the region's breadbasket.
gz2.ziel.seemacht.text: Following the “Blue Homeland” doctrine: first the shipyards, then sea power in the eastern Mediterranean, finally a world-class shipbuilding industry.
gz2.grund.erreicht: All stages of this goal are reached.
gz2.grund.zuviele: At most {n} big goals at once: a government must set priorities.
gz2.grund.sperre: After the failed attempt, only again in {tage} days.
gz2.grund.schwelle: The requirements are not yet met.
gz2.grund.vertretungVoll: The mission is already fully expanded.
gz2.x.weg.warum: The chance of the next attempt rises by {plus} percentage points; without care the preparation fades.
gz2.x.erfolg.text: The attempt succeeds (chance was about {chance} %). “{ziel}” reaches the stage “{stufe}”. Rivals push back.
gz2.x.teilerfolg.text: Narrow: “{stufe}” comes, but weakened (chance was about {chance} %). The effect is half as large; the next stage becomes harder.
gz2.x.scheitern.text: The attempt for “{ziel}” fails (chance was about {chance} %). Standing and partners' trust suffer; a new attempt is only possible in a year.
gz2.x.wurf: Chance about {chance} %; the outcome was not certain.
gz2.x.vertretung.warum: More diplomats, a trade and cultural centre: trust and trade grow, big goals with this country become more likely.
gz2.ui.einleitung: Goals over years, up to utopia. Each stage has requirements; even then the outcome is not certain. Ways raise the chance, the attempt decides. At most {max} goals at once ({n} pursued).
gz2.ui.abgeschwaecht: last reached only in weakened form
gz2.ui.vertretung.2: Embassy with trade and cultural centre
zweck.tab.grosseziele: What your government should leave behind: goals with stages up to utopia, with requirements, chance and ways.
